title: Custom traces
proposal: `Trace.beginSection` in `LoaderTask` (workspace, bind, all apps), `PreferenceManager2.<init>`, `IconPack.loadInternal`, `doSearch`→`onSearchResult` and `updateHeaderScroll`

title: Full reload and wipe of the icon cache on every `onCreate`, plus 2 DB read bugs
evidence: `lawnchair/res/values/config.xml:110` (`always_reload_icons=true`). `LawnchairLauncher.kt:252,498-503` (does not check that there is an icon pack, although the KDoc says so). `LauncherAppState.java:237-242`. `BaseIconCache.java:187-199` (`mIconDb.clear(); mCache.clear()`). `LauncherModel.java:311-323` (restarts the loader). Bug C-1: `BaseIconCache.java:682`, `c.getBlob(2)` on `icon_color`, which is INTEGER; it throws SQLiteException and the `catch` does `return false`, so it silently re-renders. Bug C-2: `BaseIconCache.java:666`, `c.getInt(0)` (componentName) on API < 33, so the color comes out as 0xFF000000
proposal: 1) Default value `false`, or reload only if there is an icon pack and its `versionCode`/`lastUpdateTime` changed (stored in a pref). 2) Use `data` or `getBlob(INDEX_ICON)`. 3) Use `getInt(INDEX_COLOR)` on all versions. All three in the same PR

title: The cache state key is built from lazy fields
status: HYPOTHESIS: only with themed icons. Measure with a log of `iconState` versus `ICON_STATE` over 3 startups
proposal: Compute `iconPackVersion` and `isThemeEnabled` from the prefs before the first `getSystemIconState`

title: `ACTION_TIME_TICK` refreshes the model every minute for each clock in the pack
evidence: `LawnchairIconProvider.kt:308-327`. Only with an icon pack (the default pref is `""`). Lawnicons used only as a themed icon does not trigger it
proposal: Remove TICK and keep TIMEZONE, TIME_CHANGED and DATE_CHANGED; `ClockDrawableWrapper` already animates itself

title: Double shadow with software `BlurMaskFilter` and an ARGB copy on every adaptive icon
proposal: Remove `recreateIcon` for adaptive icons, or do it only in modest mode

title: The appfilter is parsed in every process, the loader blocks and the maps are not thread-safe
proposal: `ConcurrentHashMap` and `@Volatile`; serialize the map to disk keyed by versionCode+lastUpdateTime; load `themedIconPack` only if themed icons are enabled

title: `SystemIconPack` is created anew on every call (2 per icon with an override), with `getActivityList` duplicated per profile
proposal: A single instance; `getActivityList(null, it)`

title: Pack drawables at full resolution
proposal: `ImageDecoder.setTargetSize`, or adjust the density

title: Tinting and themes on API 29: IPC and XML per icon
status: CONFIRMED (only with tinting enabled; not by default)
proposal: Cache per package and version

title: Room is opened and 3 `wal_checkpoint(full)` are run with `runBlocking` on the main thread on every `onCreate`
proposal: Do it on `Dispatchers.IO` in `onStop` or before a backup; one checkpoint is enough

title: First cold read of 2 DataStores on the main thread (live-information is read twice in the property initializers, before `init`)
proposal: Prewarm both DataStores on IO from `LawnchairProcessInitializer`; lazy remote values; persisted flag for the migration

title: Real root cause of the icon cache wipe: `restoreMissingPopupOptions` writes `launcherPopupOrder` on every `onCreate`. Its `onSet` calls `reloadGrid()`, which leads to `InvariantDeviceProfile.onConfigChanged`, which calls `reloadIcons()` unconditionally. The result is a grid reload, an icon DB wipe and a loader restart on every startup
evidence: `LauncherOptionsPopup.kt:31-41`, `PreferenceManager2.kt:311-315`, `InvariantDeviceProfile.java:556,583`. Confirmed on the device with the `refreshAndReloadLauncher` trace and with the DB query (0 rows read, 101 in the file)
proposal: Write only if `missingItems.isNotEmpty()` (done). Pending: make `onConfigChanged` reload icons only if `fillResIconDpi`/`iconBitmapSize` change (EVG-3h)

title: `InvariantDeviceProfile.onConfigChanged` calls `reloadIcons()` unconditionally, added by Lawnchair (any grid or configuration change wipes the icon cache)
proposal: Reload only if `iconBitmapSize` or `fillResIconDpi` change

title: Smartspace queries the GSA widgets and opens an `AppWidgetHost` eagerly
proposal: Create `widget` lazily, only if `smartspaceAagWidget` and GSA justify it

title: The bug reporter does 3 IPCs and disk I/O before `Application.onCreate`

title: Inter fonts (about 580 KB) parsed on the main thread at process start

title: ProfileInstaller does not run, so the APK's baseline profile never reaches ART
status: CONFIRMED (that the installer is missing); refuted that the profile is not packaged
evidence: `AndroidManifest-common.xml:188-191` removes `InitializationProvider`; there are no calls to `ProfileInstaller` (the receiver is still in the merged manifest). The profile is packaged: the release contains `assets/dexopt/baseline.prof` (12.8 KB) and `baseline.profm` (checked with `unzip -l`), so the plugin picks it up even though it is in `src/lawnWithQuickstepRelease/`
proposal: Run `ProfileInstaller.writeProfile(context)` in the background about 5 s after the first frame. Extend the generator: drawer, scroll, search. Add `nightly` to the module
